description: CrbonFree helps people estimate and offset the carbon footprint of everyday purchases. Enter what you bought (with optional price, category, quantity, or weight), and the app returns an emissions estimate and a clear offset cost. Users can complete the offset through Stripe checkout, and the app keeps the payment flow and status in sync.

defaultPrompt: I bought Nike shoes for $150 and want to offset the carbon impact.
